integrity: All-order closure, symmetric-obstruction and realization proofs given; finite exhaustive table checks are corroborative, not an infinite certificate. Semantics distinct from a uniform free-calculus term.
scientific_limitations: Finite BMI algebras only for the equivalence to bands; arbitrary finite BM algebras need not be associative. All extremal constructions allow B=M=I. Priority may exist in older band literature; no claim of independent review.
title: Exact fixed-point loci and sharp cardinality gaps in finite BMI algebras
